title: The Old Spring, work day 3 (the spade)
about: Spring 9, 08:00: two work days done (the rockfall is down to its last stones). Tap the site for day 3: two spade cuts throw soil to both banks, the cut settles, and the pool's water runs into it with a foam line on its front (about 1.8 s). The spring opens the next morning.
